# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Solves the AC-OPF problem based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from pyomo.environ import *
from pyomo.opt import SolverFactory
import sys


class ACOPFSolver:
    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver"""

    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.base_MVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network_data()

    def parse_network_data(self):
        """Parse network data into dictionaries"""
        # Buses
        self.buses = {}
        for bus_data in self.data['bus']:
            bus_id = int(bus_data[0])
            self.buses[bus_id] = {
                'type': int(bus_data[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
                'pd_mw': bus_data[2],  # Load (MW)
                'qd_mvar': bus_data[3],  # Load (MVAr)
                'gs': bus_data[4],  # Shunt conductance
                'bs': bus_data[5],  # Shunt susceptance
                'vmax': bus_data[11],  # Max voltage
                'vmin': bus_data[12],  # Min voltage
                'base_kv': bus_data[9]
            }

        # Generators
        self.generators = {}
        gen_id = 1
        for gen_data in self.data['gen']:
            if int(gen_data[7]) == 1:  # Only in-service generators
                bus_id = int(gen_data[0])
                self.generators[gen_id] = {
                    'bus': bus_id,
                    'pg_mw': gen_data[1],
                    'qg_mvar': gen_data[2],
                    'qmax': gen_data[3],
                    'qmin': gen_data[4],
                    'pmax': gen_data[8],
                    'pmin': gen_data[9],
                    'status': int(gen_data[7])
                }
                gen_id += 1

        # Branches
        self.branches = {}
        branch_id = 1
        for branch_data in self.data['branch']:
            if int(branch_data[10]) == 1:  # Only in-service branches
                from_bus = int(branch_data[0])
                to_bus = int(branch_data[1])
                self.branches[branch_id] = {
                    'from_bus': from_bus,
                    'to_bus': to_bus,
                    'r': branch_data[2],  # Resistance (pu)
                    'x': branch_data[3],  # Reactance (pu)
                    'b': branch_data[4],  # Charging susceptance (pu)
                    'rate_a': branch_data[5],  # MVA limit
                    'tap': branch_data[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
                    'shift': branch_data[9]  # Phase shift (degrees)
                }
                branch_id += 1

        # Generator costs
        self.gen_costs = {}
        gen_id = 1
        for cost_data in self.data['gencost']:
            if gen_id in self.generators:
                model = int(cost_data[0])
                ncost = int(cost_data[3])
                if model == 2:  # Polynomial cost
                    # For quadratic cost: c2*p^2 + c1*p + c0
                    if ncost == 3:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': cost_data[4],
                            'c1': cost_data[5],
                            'c0': cost_data[6]
                        }
                    elif ncost == 2:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': 0.0,
                            'c1': cost_data[4],
                            'c0': cost_data[5]
                        }
                    else:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
            gen_id += 1

    def build_model(self):
        """Build the Pyomo optimization model"""
        model = ConcreteModel()

        # Sets
        model.N = Set(initialize=self.buses.keys())  # Buses
        model.G = Set(initialize=self.generators.keys())  # Generators
        model.E = Set(initialize=self.branches.keys())  # Branches

        # Decision Variables
        # Generator active power (MW)
        model.pg = Var(model.G, bounds=lambda m, g: (
            self.generators[g]['pmin'],
            self.generators[g]['pmax']
        ))

        # Generator reactive power (MVAr)
        model.qg = Var(model.G, bounds=lambda m, g: (
            self.generators[g]['qmin'],
            self.generators[g]['qmax']
        ))

        # Bus voltage magnitude (pu)
        model.vm = Var(model.N, bounds=lambda m, i: (
            self.buses[i]['vmin'],
            self.buses[i]['vmax']
        ))

        # Bus voltage angle (radians)
        model.va = Var(model.N)

        # Branch power flows (MW) - from and to
        model.pf = Var(model.E)  # Power flow from bus
        model.pt = Var(model.E)  # Power flow to bus
        model.qf = Var(model.E)  # Reactive flow from bus
        model.qt = Var(model.E)  # Reactive flow to bus

        # Objective: Minimize generation cost
        def cost_rule(m):
            cost = 0
            for g in m.G:
                c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
                c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
                c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
                cost += c2 * m.pg[g]**2 + c1 * m.pg[g] + c0
            return cost

        model.cost = Objective(rule=cost_rule)

        # Constraints
        # 1. Reference bus angle = 0
        slack_bus = 1  # Assume bus 1 is slack
        model.ref_angle = Constraint(expr=model.va[slack_bus] == 0)

        # 2. Power flow equations - From bus i to j
        def pf_from_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180  # Convert to radians

            # Branch impedance
            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b = y.imag

            # Voltage angle difference
            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Power flow from i to j
            # P_ij = (G_ij + G_c_ij) * V_i^2 / tap^2 - G_ij * V_i * V_j * cos(theta_ij) / tap - B_ij * V_i * V_j * sin(theta_ij) / tap
            pf = (g / tap**2) * m.vm[from_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * cos(angle_diff) - \
                 (b / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.pf[e] == pf

        model.pf_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=pf_from_rule)

        # 3. Power flow equations - To bus j from i
        def pt_to_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Power flow to j from i
            # P_ji = G_ij * V_j^2 - G_ij * V_i * V_j * cos(theta_ij) / tap + B_ij * V_i * V_j * sin(theta_ij) / tap
            pt = g * m.vm[to_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * cos(angle_diff) + \
                 (b / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.pt[e] == pt

        model.pt_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=pt_to_rule)

        # 4. Reactive power flow equations - From bus
        def qf_from_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            b = self.branches[e]['b']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b_ser = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Q flow from i to j
            qf = -(b_ser / tap**2 + b / 2) * m.vm[from_bus]**2 + \
                 (b_ser / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff) - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.qf[e] == qf

        model.qf_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=qf_from_rule)

        # 5. Reactive power flow equations - To bus
        def qt_to_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            b = self.branches[e]['b']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b_ser = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Q flow to j from i
            qt = -(b_ser + b / 2) * m.vm[to_bus]**2 + \
                 (b_ser / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff) + \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.qt[e] == qt

        model.qt_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=qt_to_rule)

        # 6. Power balance equations at each bus
        def power_balance_p_rule(m, i):
            # Sum of generation - sum of loads - shunt = sum of flows
            gen_sum = sum(m.pg[g] for g in m.G if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load = self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            shunt_g = self.buses[i]['gs'] / self.base_MVA  # Convert to per-unit

            flow_out = sum(m.pf[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['from_bus'] == i)
            flow_in = sum(m.pt[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['to_bus'] == i)

            return gen_sum - load - shunt_g * m.vm[i]**2 == flow_out - flow_in

        model.power_balance_p = Constraint(model.N, rule=power_balance_p_rule)

        # 7. Reactive power balance equations
        def power_balance_q_rule(m, i):
            gen_sum = sum(m.qg[g] for g in m.G if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load = self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']
            shunt_b = self.buses[i]['bs'] / self.base_MVA  # Convert to per-unit

            flow_out = sum(m.qf[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['from_bus'] == i)
            flow_in = sum(m.qt[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['to_bus'] == i)

            return gen_sum - load + shunt_b * m.vm[i]**2 == flow_out - flow_in

        model.power_balance_q = Constraint(model.N, rule=power_balance_q_rule)

        # 8. Branch power limits (MVA)
        def branch_limit_from_rule(m, e):
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']
            if rate_a > 0:
                return m.pf[e]**2 + m.qf[e]**2 <= rate_a**2
            return Constraint.Skip

        model.branch_limit_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=branch_limit_from_rule)

        def branch_limit_to_rule(m, e):
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']
            if rate_a > 0:
                return m.pt[e]**2 + m.qt[e]**2 <= rate_a**2
            return Constraint.Skip

        model.branch_limit_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=branch_limit_to_rule)

        # 9. Voltage angle difference limits
        def angle_limit_rule(m, e):
            # Usually -30 to +30 degrees, converted to radians
            angmin = -30 * np.pi / 180
            angmax = 30 * np.pi / 180
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            return angmin <= angle_diff <= angmax

        model.angle_limit = Constraint(model.E, rule=angle_limit_rule)

        self.model = model
        return model

    def solve(self, solver_name='ipopt'):
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        model = self.build_model()

        # Create solver
        solver = SolverFactory(solver_name)

        # Set solver options
        if solver_name == 'ipopt':
            solver.options['max_iter'] = 3000
            solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
            solver.options['print_level'] = 0

        # Solve
        print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")
        results = solver.solve(model, tee=False)

        return model, results

    def extract_solution(self, model, results):
        """Extract solution from solved model"""
        # Check solver status
        if results.solver.status == SolverStatus.ok:
            if results.solver.termination_condition == TerminationCondition.optimal:
                solver_status = "optimal"
            elif results.solver.termination_condition == TerminationCondition.locallyOptimal:
                solver_status = "locally_optimal"
            else:
                solver_status = str(results.solver.termination_condition)
        else:
            solver_status = str(results.solver.status)

        # Extract generator data
        generators = []
        total_gen_p = 0
        total_gen_q = 0
        total_cost = 0

        for g in model.G:
            bus = self.generators[g]['bus']
            pg = value(model.pg[g])
            qg = value(model.qg[g])
            pmin = self.generators[g]['pmin']
            pmax = self.generators[g]['pmax']
            qmin = self.generators[g]['qmin']
            qmax = self.generators[g]['qmax']

            # Calculate cost
            c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
            c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
            c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
            cost = c2 * pg**2 + c1 * pg + c0
            total_cost += cost

            total_gen_p += pg
            total_gen_q += qg

            generators.append({
                'id': int(g),
                'bus': int(bus),
                'pg_MW': float(pg),
                'qg_MVAr': float(qg),
                'pmin_MW': float(pmin),
                'pmax_MW': float(pmax),
                'qmin_MVAr': float(qmin),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(qmax)
            })

        # Extract bus data
        buses = []
        total_load_p = 0
        total_load_q = 0
        max_p_mismatch = 0
        max_q_mismatch = 0
        max_voltage_violation = 0

        for i in model.N:
            vm = value(model.vm[i])
            va = value(model.va[i]) * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
            vmin = self.buses[i]['vmin']
            vmax = self.buses[i]['vmax']

            total_load_p += self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            total_load_q += self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']

            # Check voltage limits
            if vm < vmin:
                voltage_violation = vmin - vm
            elif vm > vmax:
                voltage_violation = vm - vmax
            else:
                voltage_violation = 0

            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, voltage_violation)

            buses.append({
                'id': int(i),
                'vm_pu': float(vm),
                'va_deg': float(va),
                'vmin_pu': float(vmin),
                'vmax_pu': float(vmax)
            })

        # Extract branch data
        branches = []
        max_branch_overload = 0

        for e in model.E:
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            pf = value(model.pf[e])
            qf = value(model.qf[e])
            pt = value(model.pt[e])
            qt = value(model.qt[e])
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']

            s_from = np.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
            s_to = np.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)

            if rate_a > 0:
                loading_pct = max(s_from, s_to) / rate_a * 100
                overload = max(s_from, s_to) - rate_a
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, max(0, overload))
            else:
                loading_pct = 0
                overload = 0

            branches.append({
                'from_bus': int(from_bus),
                'to_bus': int(to_bus),
                'loading_pct': float(loading_pct),
                'flow_from_MVA': float(s_from),
                'flow_to_MVA': float(s_to),
                'limit_MVA': float(rate_a)
            })

        # Sort branches by loading percentage (descending)
        branches_sorted = sorted(branches, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branches_sorted[:10]  # Top 10 most loaded branches

        # Calculate losses
        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        return {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': float(total_cost),
                'total_load_MW': float(total_load_p),
                'total_load_MVAr': float(total_load_q),
                'total_generation_MW': float(total_gen_p),
                'total_generation_MVAr': float(total_gen_q),
                'total_losses_MW': float(total_losses_p),
                'solver_status': solver_status
            },
            'generators': generators,
            'buses': buses,
            'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': float(max_p_mismatch),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': float(max_q_mismatch),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': float(max_voltage_violation),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': float(max_branch_overload)
            }
        }


def main():
    # Solve OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    model, results = solver.solve()

    # Extract and save results
    solution = solver.extract_solution(model, results)

    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(solution, f, indent=2)

    print("OPF Solution saved to report.json")
    print(f"Solver Status: {solution['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${solution['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:.2f}/hour")
    print(f"Total Generation: {solution['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Load: {solution['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Losses: {solution['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    def parse_network_data(self):

            self.buses[bus_id] = {

                'pd_mw': bus_data[2],  # Load (MW)
                'qd_mvar': bus_data[3],  # Load (MVAr)
                'gs': bus_data[4],  # Shunt conductance

            }

                    'tap': branch_data[8],  # Transformer tap ratio

        # Generator costs
        self.gen_costs = {}

    def build_model(self):

            pf = (g / tap**2) * m.vm[from_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * cos(angle_diff) - \
                 (b / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.pf[e] == pf

        model.pf_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=pf_from_rule)

        # 3. Power flow equations - To bus j from i
        def pt_to_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']

            pt = g * m.vm[to_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * cos(angle_diff) + \

            return m.pt[e] == pt

        model.pt_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=pt_to_rule)

        def qf_from_rule(m, e):

            b = self.branches[e]['b']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b_ser = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Q flow from i to j
            qf = -(b_ser / tap**2 + b / 2) * m.vm[from_bus]**2 + \
                 (b_ser / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff) - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.qf[e] == qf

        model.qf_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=qf_from_rule)

        # 5. Reactive power flow equations - To bus
        def qt_to_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            b = self.branches[e]['b']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b_ser = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Q flow to j from i
            qt = -(b_ser + b / 2) * m.vm[to_bus]**2 + \
                 (b_ser / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff) + \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.qt[e] == qt

        model.qt_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=qt_to_rule)

        # 6. Power balance equations at each bus
        def power_balance_p_rule(m, i):
            # Sum of generation - sum of loads - shunt = sum of flows
            gen_sum = sum(m.pg[g] for g in m.G if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load = self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            shunt_g = self.buses[i]['gs'] / self.base_MVA  # Convert to per-unit

            flow_out = sum(m.pf[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['from_bus'] == i)
            flow_in = sum(m.pt[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['to_bus'] == i)

            return gen_sum - load - shunt_g * m.vm[i]**2 == flow_out - flow_in

        model.power_balance_p = Constraint(model.N, rule=power_balance_p_rule)

        # 7. Reactive power balance equations
        def power_balance_q_rule(m, i):
            gen_sum = sum(m.qg[g] for g in m.G if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load = self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']
            shunt_b = self.buses[i]['bs'] / self.base_MVA  # Convert to per-unit

            flow_out = sum(m.qf[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['from_bus'] == i)
            flow_in = sum(m.qt[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['to_bus'] == i)

            return gen_sum - load + shunt_b * m.vm[i]**2 == flow_out - flow_in

        model.power_balance_q = Constraint(model.N, rule=power_balance_q_rule)

        # 8. Branch power limits (MVA)
        def branch_limit_from_rule(m, e):
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']
            if rate_a > 0:
                return m.pf[e]**2 + m.qf[e]**2 <= rate_a**2
            return Constraint.Skip

        model.branch_limit_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=branch_limit_from_rule)

        def branch_limit_to_rule(m, e):
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']
            if rate_a > 0:
                return m.pt[e]**2 + m.qt[e]**2 <= rate_a**2
            return Constraint.Skip

        model.branch_limit_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=branch_limit_to_rule)

        # 9. Voltage angle difference limits
        def angle_limit_rule(m, e):
            # Usually -30 to +30 degrees, converted to radians
            angmin = -30 * np.pi / 180
            angmax = 30 * np.pi / 180
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            return angmin <= angle_diff <= angmax

        model.angle_limit = Constraint(model.E, rule=angle_limit_rule)

        self.model = model
        return model

    def solve(self, solver_name='ipopt'):
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        model = self.build_model()

        # Create solver
        solver = SolverFactory(solver_name)

        # Set solver options
        if solver_name == 'ipopt':
            solver.options['max_iter'] = 3000
            solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
            solver.options['print_level'] = 0

        # Solve
        print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")
        results = solver.solve(model, tee=False)

        return model, results

    def extract_solution(self, model, results):
        """Extract solution from solved model"""
        # Check solver status
        if results.solver.status == SolverStatus.ok:
            if results.solver.termination_condition == TerminationCondition.optimal:
                solver_status = "optimal"
            elif results.solver.termination_condition == TerminationCondition.locallyOptimal:
                solver_status = "locally_optimal"
            else:
                solver_status = str(results.solver.termination_condition)
        else:
            solver_status = str(results.solver.status)

        # Extract generator data
        generators = []
        total_gen_p = 0
        total_gen_q = 0
        total_cost = 0

        for g in model.G:
            bus = self.generators[g]['bus']
            pg = value(model.pg[g])
            qg = value(model.qg[g])
            pmin = self.generators[g]['pmin']
            pmax = self.generators[g]['pmax']
            qmin = self.generators[g]['qmin']
            qmax = self.generators[g]['qmax']

            # Calculate cost
            c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
            c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
            c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
            cost = c2 * pg**2 + c1 * pg + c0
            total_cost += cost

            total_gen_p += pg
            total_gen_q += qg

            generators.append({
                'id': int(g),
                'bus': int(bus),
                'pg_MW': float(pg),
                'qg_MVAr': float(qg),
                'pmin_MW': float(pmin),
                'pmax_MW': float(pmax),
                'qmin_MVAr': float(qmin),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(qmax)
            })

        # Extract bus data
        buses = []
        total_load_p = 0
        total_load_q = 0
        max_p_mismatch = 0
        max_q_mismatch = 0
        max_voltage_violation = 0

        for i in model.N:
            vm = value(model.vm[i])
            va = value(model.va[i]) * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
            vmin = self.buses[i]['vmin']
            vmax = self.buses[i]['vmax']

            total_load_p += self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            total_load_q += self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']

            # Check voltage limits
            if vm < vmin:
                voltage_violation = vmin - vm
            elif vm > vmax:
                voltage_violation = vm - vmax
            else:
                voltage_violation = 0

            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, voltage_violation)

            buses.append({
                'id': int(i),
                'vm_pu': float(vm),
                'va_deg': float(va),
                'vmin_pu': float(vmin),
                'vmax_pu': float(vmax)
            })

        # Extract branch data
        branches = []
        max_branch_overload = 0

        for e in model.E:
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            pf = value(model.pf[e])
            qf = value(model.qf[e])
            pt = value(model.pt[e])
            qt = value(model.qt[e])
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']

            s_from = np.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
            s_to = np.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)

            if rate_a > 0:
                loading_pct = max(s_from, s_to) / rate_a * 100
                overload = max(s_from, s_to) - rate_a
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, max(0, overload))
            else:
                loading_pct = 0
                overload = 0

            branches.append({
                'from_bus': int(from_bus),
                'to_bus': int(to_bus),
                'loading_pct': float(loading_pct),
                'flow_from_MVA': float(s_from),
                'flow_to_MVA': float(s_to),
                'limit_MVA': float(rate_a)
            })

        # Sort branches by loading percentage (descending)
        branches_sorted = sorted(branches, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branches_sorted[:10]  # Top 10 most loaded branches

        # Calculate losses
        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        return {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': float(total_cost),
                'total_load_MW': float(total_load_p),
                'total_load_MVAr': float(total_load_q),
                'total_generation_MW': float(total_gen_p),
                'total_generation_MVAr': float(total_gen_q),
                'total_losses_MW': float(total_losses_p),
                'solver_status': solver_status
            },
            'generators': generators,
            'buses': buses,
            'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': float(max_p_mismatch),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': float(max_q_mismatch),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': float(max_voltage_violation),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': float(max_branch_overload)
            }
        }


def main():
    # Solve OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    model, results = solver.solve()

    # Extract and save results
    solution = solver.extract_solution(model, results)

    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(solution, f, indent=2)

    print("OPF Solution saved to report.json")
    print(f"Solver Status: {solution['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${solution['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:.2f}/hour")
    print(f"Total Generation: {solution['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Load: {solution['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Losses: {solution['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Solves the AC-OPF problem based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Uses scipy.optimize for the optimization
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
import sys


class ACOPFSolver:
    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver"""

    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.base_MVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network_data()

    def parse_network_data(self):
        """Parse network data into dictionaries"""
        # Buses
        self.buses = {}
        self.bus_list = []
        for bus_data in self.data['bus']:
            bus_id = int(bus_data[0])
            self.buses[bus_id] = {
                'type': int(bus_data[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
                'pd_mw': bus_data[2],  # Load (MW)
                'qd_mvar': bus_data[3],  # Load (MVAr)
                'gs': bus_data[4],  # Shunt conductance
                'bs': bus_data[5],  # Shunt susceptance
                'vmax': bus_data[11],  # Max voltage
                'vmin': bus_data[12],  # Min voltage
                'base_kv': bus_data[9]
            }
            self.bus_list.append(bus_id)

        self.bus_list.sort()
        self.bus_idx_map = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(self.bus_list)}

        # Generators
        self.generators = {}
        self.gen_list = []
        gen_id = 1
        for gen_data in self.data['gen']:
            if int(gen_data[7]) == 1:  # Only in-service generators
                bus_id = int(gen_data[0])
                self.generators[gen_id] = {
                    'bus': bus_id,
                    'pg_mw': gen_data[1],
                    'qg_mvar': gen_data[2],
                    'qmax': gen_data[3],
                    'qmin': gen_data[4],
                    'pmax': gen_data[8],
                    'pmin': gen_data[9],
                    'status': int(gen_data[7])
                }
                self.gen_list.append(gen_id)
                gen_id += 1

        # Branches
        self.branches = {}
        self.branch_list = []
        branch_id = 1
        for branch_data in self.data['branch']:
            if int(branch_data[10]) == 1:  # Only in-service branches
                from_bus = int(branch_data[0])
                to_bus = int(branch_data[1])
                self.branches[branch_id] = {
                    'from_bus': from_bus,
                    'to_bus': to_bus,
                    'r': branch_data[2],  # Resistance (pu)
                    'x': branch_data[3],  # Reactance (pu)
                    'b': branch_data[4],  # Charging susceptance (pu)
                    'rate_a': branch_data[5],  # MVA limit
                    'tap': branch_data[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
                    'shift': branch_data[9]  # Phase shift (degrees)
                }
                self.branch_list.append(branch_id)
                branch_id += 1

        # Generator costs
        self.gen_costs = {}
        gen_id = 1
        for cost_data in self.data['gencost']:
            if gen_id in self.generators:
                model = int(cost_data[0])
                ncost = int(cost_data[3])
                if model == 2:  # Polynomial cost
                    # For quadratic cost: c2*p^2 + c1*p + c0
                    if ncost == 3:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': cost_data[4],
                            'c1': cost_data[5],
                            'c0': cost_data[6]
                        }
                    elif ncost == 2:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': 0.0,
                            'c1': cost_data[4],
                            'c0': cost_data[5]
                        }
                    else:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
            gen_id += 1

    def get_bounds(self):
        """Get variable bounds"""
        n_buses = len(self.bus_list)
        n_gens = len(self.gen_list)

        bounds = []

        # Generator active power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            bounds.append((self.generators[g]['pmin'], self.generators[g]['pmax']))

        # Generator reactive power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            bounds.append((self.generators[g]['qmin'], self.generators[g]['qmax']))

        # Bus voltage magnitudes
        for b in self.bus_list:
            bounds.append((self.buses[b]['vmin'], self.buses[b]['vmax']))

        # Bus voltage angles (unrestricted, but reasonable bounds)
        for b in self.bus_list:
            if self.buses[b]['type'] == 3:  # Slack bus
                bounds.append((0, 0))  # Fixed at 0
            else:
                bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        return bounds

    def pack_variables(self, pg_dict, qg_dict, vm_dict, va_dict):
        """Pack variables into a single vector"""
        x = []

        # Generator active power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            x.append(pg_dict.get(g, self.generators[g]['pmin']))

        # Generator reactive power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            x.append(qg_dict.get(g, 0.0))

        # Bus voltage magnitudes
        for b in self.bus_list:
            x.append(vm_dict.get(b, 1.0))

        # Bus voltage angles
        for b in self.bus_list:
            x.append(va_dict.get(b, 0.0))

        return np.array(x)

    def unpack_variables(self, x):
        """Unpack variables from a single vector"""
        n_gens = len(self.gen_list)
        n_buses = len(self.bus_list)

        pg = {}
        qg = {}
        vm = {}
        va = {}

        idx = 0

        # Generator active power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            pg[g] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        # Generator reactive power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            qg[g] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        # Bus voltage magnitudes
        for b in self.bus_list:
            vm[b] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        # Bus voltage angles
        for b in self.bus_list:
            va[b] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        return pg, qg, vm, va

    def objective(self, x):
        """Objective function: minimize generation cost"""
        pg, qg, vm, va = self.unpack_variables(x)

        cost = 0
        for g in self.gen_list:
            c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
            c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
            c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
            cost += c2 * pg[g]**2 + c1 * pg[g] + c0

        return cost

    def power_balance_constraints(self, x):
        """Power balance constraints"""
        pg, qg, vm, va = self.unpack_variables(x)

        constraints = []

        for i in self.bus_list:
            # Real power balance
            gen_p = sum(pg[g] for g in self.gen_list if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load_p = self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            shunt_g = self.buses[i]['gs'] / self.base_MVA

            flow_out_p = 0
            flow_in_p = 0

            for e in self.branch_list:
                from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
                to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
                r = self.branches[e]['r']
                x_b = self.branches[e]['x']
                tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
                shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

                z = r + 1j * x_b
                if abs(z) > 1e-10:
                    y = 1.0 / z
                    g = y.real
                    b = y.imag
                else:
                    g = 0
                    b = 0

                angle_diff = va[from_bus] - va[to_bus] - shift

                if from_bus == i:
                    pf = (g / tap**2) * vm[from_bus]**2 - \
                         (g / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.cos(angle_diff) - \
                         (b / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_out_p += pf

                if to_bus == i:
                    pt = g * vm[to_bus]**2 - \
                         (g / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.cos(angle_diff) + \
                         (b / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_in_p += pt

            constraint = gen_p - load_p - shunt_g * vm[i]**2 - (flow_out_p - flow_in_p)
            constraints.append(constraint)

            # Reactive power balance
            gen_q = sum(qg[g] for g in self.gen_list if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load_q = self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']
            shunt_b = self.buses[i]['bs'] / self.base_MVA

            flow_out_q = 0
            flow_in_q = 0

            for e in self.branch_list:
                from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
                to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
                r = self.branches[e]['r']
                x_b = self.branches[e]['x']
                b_ch = self.branches[e]['b']
                tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
                shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

                z = r + 1j * x_b
                if abs(z) > 1e-10:
                    y = 1.0 / z
                    g = y.real
                    b_ser = y.imag
                else:
                    g = 0
                    b_ser = 0

                angle_diff = va[from_bus] - va[to_bus] - shift

                if from_bus == i:
                    qf = -(b_ser / tap**2 + b_ch / 2) * vm[from_bus]**2 + \
                         (b_ser / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff) - \
                         (g / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_out_q += qf

                if to_bus == i:
                    qt = -(b_ser + b_ch / 2) * vm[to_bus]**2 + \
                         (b_ser / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff) + \
                         (g / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_in_q += qt

            constraint = gen_q - load_q + shunt_b * vm[i]**2 - (flow_out_q - flow_in_q)
            constraints.append(constraint)

        return np.array(constraints)

    def solve(self):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Solves the AC-OPF problem based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Uses scipy.optimize for the optimization
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
import sys


class ACOPFSolver:
    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver"""

    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.base_MVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network_data()

    def parse_network_data(self):
        """Parse network data into dictionaries"""
        # Buses
        self.buses = {}
        self.bus_list = []
        for bus_data in self.data['bus']:
            bus_id = int(bus_data[0])
            self.buses[bus_id] = {
                'type': int(bus_data[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
                'pd_mw': bus_data[2],  # Load (MW)
                'qd_mvar': bus_data[3],  # Load (MVAr)
                'gs': bus_data[4],  # Shunt conductance
                'bs': bus_data[5],  # Shunt susceptance
                'vmax': bus_data[11],  # Max voltage
                'vmin': bus_data[12],  # Min voltage
                'base_kv': bus_data[9]
            }
            self.bus_list.append(bus_id)

        self.bus_list.sort()
        self.bus_idx_map = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(self.bus_list)}

        # Generators
        self.generators = {}
        self.gen_list = []
        gen_id = 1
        for gen_data in self.data['gen']:
            if int(gen_data[7]) == 1:  # Only in-service generators
                bus_id = int(gen_data[0])
                self.generators[gen_id] = {
                    'bus': bus_id,
                    'pg_mw': gen_data[1],
                    'qg_mvar': gen_data[2],
                    'qmax': gen_data[3],
                    'qmin': gen_data[4],
                    'pmax': gen_data[8],
                    'pmin': gen_data[9],
                    'status': int(gen_data[7])
                }
                self.gen_list.append(gen_id)
                gen_id += 1

        # Branches
        self.branches = {}
        self.branch_list = []
        branch_id = 1
        for branch_data in self.data['branch']:
            if int(branch_data[10]) == 1:  # Only in-service branches
                from_bus = int(branch_data[0])
                to_bus = int(branch_data[1])
                self.branches[branch_id] = {
                    'from_bus': from_bus,
                    'to_bus': to_bus,
                    'r': branch_data[2],  # Resistance (pu)
                    'x': branch_data[3],  # Reactance (pu)
                    'b': branch_data[4],  # Charging susceptance (pu)
                    'rate_a': branch_data[5],  # MVA limit
                    'tap': branch_data[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
                    'shift': branch_data[9]  # Phase shift (degrees)
                }
                self.branch_list.append(branch_id)
                branch_id += 1

        # Generator costs
        self.gen_costs = {}
        gen_id = 1
        for cost_data in self.data['gencost']:
            if gen_id in self.generators:
                model = int(cost_data[0])
                ncost = int(cost_data[3])
                if model == 2:  # Polynomial cost
                    # For quadratic cost: c2*p^2 + c1*p + c0
                    if ncost == 3:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': cost_data[4],
                            'c1': cost_data[5],
                            'c0': cost_data[6]
                        }
                    elif ncost == 2:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': 0.0,
                            'c1': cost_data[4],
                            'c0': cost_data[5]
                        }
                    else:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
            gen_id += 1

    def get_bounds(self):
        """Get variable bounds"""
        n_buses = len(self.bus_list)
        n_gens = len(self.gen_list)

        bounds = []

        # Generator active power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            bounds.append((self.generators[g]['pmin'], self.generators[g]['pmax']))

        # Generator reactive power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            bounds.append((self.generators[g]['qmin'], self.generators[g]['qmax']))

        # Bus voltage magnitudes
        for b in self.bus_list:
            bounds.append((self.buses[b]['vmin'], self.buses[b]['vmax']))

        # Bus voltage angles (unrestricted, but reasonable bounds)
        for b in self.bus_list:
            if self.buses[b]['type'] == 3:  # Slack bus
                bounds.append((0, 0))  # Fixed at 0
            else:
                bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        return bounds

    def pack_variables(self, pg_dict, qg_dict, vm_dict, va_dict):
        """Pack variables into a single vector"""
        x = []

        # Generator active power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            x.append(pg_dict.get(g, self.generators[g]['pmin']))

        # Generator reactive power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            x.append(qg_dict.get(g, 0.0))

        # Bus voltage magnitudes
        for b in self.bus_list:
            x.append(vm_dict.get(b, 1.0))

        # Bus voltage angles
        for b in self.bus_list:
            x.append(va_dict.get(b, 0.0))

        return np.array(x)

    def unpack_variables(self, x):
        """Unpack variables from a single vector"""
        n_gens = len(self.gen_list)
        n_buses = len(self.bus_list)

        pg = {}
        qg = {}
        vm = {}
        va = {}

        idx = 0

        # Generator active power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            pg[g] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        # Generator reactive power
        for g in self.gen_list:
            qg[g] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        # Bus voltage magnitudes
        for b in self.bus_list:
            vm[b] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        # Bus voltage angles
        for b in self.bus_list:
            va[b] = x[idx]
            idx += 1

        return pg, qg, vm, va

    def objective(self, x):
        """Objective function: minimize generation cost"""
        pg, qg, vm, va = self.unpack_variables(x)

        cost = 0
        for g in self.gen_list:
            c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
            c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
            c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
            cost += c2 * pg[g]**2 + c1 * pg[g] + c0

        return cost

    def power_balance_constraints(self, x):
        """Power balance constraints"""
        pg, qg, vm, va = self.unpack_variables(x)

        constraints = []

        for i in self.bus_list:
            # Real power balance
            gen_p = sum(pg[g] for g in self.gen_list if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load_p = self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            shunt_g = self.buses[i]['gs'] / self.base_MVA

            flow_out_p = 0
            flow_in_p = 0

            for e in self.branch_list:
                from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
                to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
                r = self.branches[e]['r']
                x_b = self.branches[e]['x']
                tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
                shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

                z = r + 1j * x_b
                if abs(z) > 1e-10:
                    y = 1.0 / z
                    g = y.real
                    b = y.imag
                else:
                    g = 0
                    b = 0

                angle_diff = va[from_bus] - va[to_bus] - shift

                if from_bus == i:
                    pf = (g / tap**2) * vm[from_bus]**2 - \
                         (g / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.cos(angle_diff) - \
                         (b / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_out_p += pf

                if to_bus == i:
                    pt = g * vm[to_bus]**2 - \
                         (g / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.cos(angle_diff) + \
                         (b / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_in_p += pt

            constraint = gen_p - load_p - shunt_g * vm[i]**2 - (flow_out_p - flow_in_p)
            constraints.append(constraint)

            # Reactive power balance
            gen_q = sum(qg[g] for g in self.gen_list if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load_q = self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']
            shunt_b = self.buses[i]['bs'] / self.base_MVA

            flow_out_q = 0
            flow_in_q = 0

            for e in self.branch_list:
                from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
                to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
                r = self.branches[e]['r']
                x_b = self.branches[e]['x']
                b_ch = self.branches[e]['b']
                tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
                shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

                z = r + 1j * x_b
                if abs(z) > 1e-10:
                    y = 1.0 / z
                    g = y.real
                    b_ser = y.imag
                else:
                    g = 0
                    b_ser = 0

                angle_diff = va[from_bus] - va[to_bus] - shift

                if from_bus == i:
                    qf = -(b_ser / tap**2 + b_ch / 2) * vm[from_bus]**2 + \
                         (b_ser / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff) - \
                         (g / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_out_q += qf

                if to_bus == i:
                    qt = -(b_ser + b_ch / 2) * vm[to_bus]**2 + \
                         (b_ser / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff) + \
                         (g / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)
                    flow_in_q += qt

            constraint = gen_q - load_q + shunt_b * vm[i]**2 - (flow_out_q - flow_in_q)
            constraints.append(constraint)

        return np.array(constraints)

    def solve(self):
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")

        # Initial guess
        x0 = self.pack_variables({}, {}, {}, {})

        # Bounds
        bounds = self.get_bounds()

        # Power balance constraints (equality)
        def constraint_func(x):
            return self.power_balance_constraints(x)

        constraints = NonlinearConstraint(constraint_func, 0, 0, jac='3-point')

        # Solve
        result = minimize(
            self.objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=constraints,
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6}
        )

        return result

    def extract_solution(self, result):
        """Extract solution from optimization result"""
        pg, qg, vm, va = self.unpack_variables(result.x)

        if result.success:
            solver_status = "optimal"
        else:
            solver_status = "not_converged"

        # Extract generator data
        generators = []
        total_gen_p = 0
        total_gen_q = 0
        total_cost = 0

        for g in self.gen_list:
            bus = self.generators[g]['bus']
            pg_val = pg[g]
            qg_val = qg[g]
            pmin = self.generators[g]['pmin']
            pmax = self.generators[g]['pmax']
            qmin = self.generators[g]['qmin']
            qmax = self.generators[g]['qmax']

            # Calculate cost
            c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
            c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
            c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
            cost = c2 * pg_val**2 + c1 * pg_val + c0
            total_cost += cost

            total_gen_p += pg_val
            total_gen_q += qg_val

            generators.append({
                'id': int(g),
                'bus': int(bus),
                'pg_MW': float(pg_val),
                'qg_MVAr': float(qg_val),
                'pmin_MW': float(pmin),
                'pmax_MW': float(pmax),
                'qmin_MVAr': float(qmin),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(qmax)
            })

        # Extract bus data
        buses = []
        total_load_p = 0
        total_load_q = 0
        max_p_mismatch = 0
        max_q_mismatch = 0
        max_voltage_violation = 0

        for i in self.bus_list:
            vm_val = vm[i]
            va_val = va[i] * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
            vmin = self.buses[i]['vmin']
            vmax = self.buses[i]['vmax']

            total_load_p += self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            total_load_q += self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']

            # Check voltage limits
            if vm_val < vmin:
                voltage_violation = vmin - vm_val
            elif vm_val > vmax:
                voltage_violation = vm_val - vmax
            else:
                voltage_violation = 0

            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, voltage_violation)

            buses.append({
                'id': int(i),
                'vm_pu': float(vm_val),
                'va_deg': float(va_val),
                'vmin_pu': float(vmin),
                'vmax_pu': float(vmax)
            })

        # Extract branch data
        branches = []
        max_branch_overload = 0

        for e in self.branch_list:
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x_b = self.branches[e]['x']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x_b
            if abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
                g = y.real
                b = y.imag
            else:
                g = 0
                b = 0

            angle_diff = va[from_bus] - va[to_bus] - shift

            pf = (g / tap**2) * vm[from_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.cos(angle_diff) - \
                 (b / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)

            pt = g * vm[to_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.cos(angle_diff) + \
                 (b / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)

            qf = -(b / tap**2 + self.branches[e]['b'] / 2) * vm[from_bus]**2 + \
                 (b / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff) - \
                 (g / tap) * vm[from_bus] * vm[to_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)

            qt = -(b + self.branches[e]['b'] / 2) * vm[to_bus]**2 + \
                 (b / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff) + \
                 (g / tap) * vm[to_bus] * vm[from_bus] * np.sin(angle_diff)

            s_from = np.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
            s_to = np.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)

            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']

            if rate_a > 0:
                loading_pct = max(s_from, s_to) / rate_a * 100
                overload = max(s_from, s_to) - rate_a
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, max(0, overload))
            else:
                loading_pct = 0
                overload = 0

            branches.append({
                'from_bus': int(from_bus),
                'to_bus': int(to_bus),
                'loading_pct': float(loading_pct),
                'flow_from_MVA': float(s_from),
                'flow_to_MVA': float(s_to),
                'limit_MVA': float(rate_a)
            })

        # Sort branches by loading percentage (descending)
        branches_sorted = sorted(branches, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branches_sorted[:10]  # Top 10 most loaded branches

        # Calculate losses
        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        return {

                'total_load_MW': float(total_load_p),

            'feasibility_check': {

                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': float(max_q_mismatch),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': float(max_voltage_violation),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': float(max_branch_overload)
            }
        }


def main():
    # Solve OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    result = solver.solve()

    # Extract and save results
    solution = solver.extract_solution(result)

    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(solution, f, indent=2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Solves the AC-OPF problem based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from pyomo.environ import *
from pyomo.opt import SolverFactory
import sys


class ACOPFSolver:
    """AC Optimal Power Flow Solver"""

    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.base_MVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network_data()

    def parse_network_data(self):
        """Parse network data into dictionaries"""
        # Buses
        self.buses = {}
        for bus_data in self.data['bus']:
            bus_id = int(bus_data[0])
            self.buses[bus_id] = {
                'type': int(bus_data[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
                'pd_mw': bus_data[2],  # Load (MW)
                'qd_mvar': bus_data[3],  # Load (MVAr)
                'gs': bus_data[4],  # Shunt conductance
                'bs': bus_data[5],  # Shunt susceptance
                'vmax': bus_data[11],  # Max voltage
                'vmin': bus_data[12],  # Min voltage
                'base_kv': bus_data[9]
            }

        # Generators
        self.generators = {}
        gen_id = 1
        for gen_data in self.data['gen']:
            if int(gen_data[7]) == 1:  # Only in-service generators
                bus_id = int(gen_data[0])
                self.generators[gen_id] = {
                    'bus': bus_id,
                    'pg_mw': gen_data[1],
                    'qg_mvar': gen_data[2],
                    'qmax': gen_data[3],
                    'qmin': gen_data[4],
                    'pmax': gen_data[8],
                    'pmin': gen_data[9],
                    'status': int(gen_data[7])
                }
                gen_id += 1

        # Branches
        self.branches = {}
        branch_id = 1
        for branch_data in self.data['branch']:
            if int(branch_data[10]) == 1:  # Only in-service branches
                from_bus = int(branch_data[0])
                to_bus = int(branch_data[1])
                self.branches[branch_id] = {
                    'from_bus': from_bus,
                    'to_bus': to_bus,
                    'r': branch_data[2],  # Resistance (pu)
                    'x': branch_data[3],  # Reactance (pu)
                    'b': branch_data[4],  # Charging susceptance (pu)
                    'rate_a': branch_data[5],  # MVA limit
                    'tap': branch_data[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
                    'shift': branch_data[9]  # Phase shift (degrees)
                }
                branch_id += 1

        # Generator costs
        self.gen_costs = {}
        gen_id = 1
        for cost_data in self.data['gencost']:
            if gen_id in self.generators:
                model = int(cost_data[0])
                ncost = int(cost_data[3])
                if model == 2:  # Polynomial cost
                    # For quadratic cost: c2*p^2 + c1*p + c0
                    if ncost == 3:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': cost_data[4],
                            'c1': cost_data[5],
                            'c0': cost_data[6]
                        }
                    elif ncost == 2:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {
                            'c2': 0.0,
                            'c1': cost_data[4],
                            'c0': cost_data[5]
                        }
                    else:
                        self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
                else:
                    self.gen_costs[gen_id] = {'c2': 0.0, 'c1': 1.0, 'c0': 0.0}
            gen_id += 1

    def build_model(self):
        """Build the Pyomo optimization model"""
        model = ConcreteModel()

        # Sets
        model.N = Set(initialize=self.buses.keys())  # Buses
        model.G = Set(initialize=self.generators.keys())  # Generators
        model.E = Set(initialize=self.branches.keys())  # Branches

        # Decision Variables
        # Generator active power (MW)
        model.pg = Var(model.G, bounds=lambda m, g: (
            self.generators[g]['pmin'],
            self.generators[g]['pmax']
        ))

        # Generator reactive power (MVAr)
        model.qg = Var(model.G, bounds=lambda m, g: (
            self.generators[g]['qmin'],
            self.generators[g]['qmax']
        ))

        # Bus voltage magnitude (pu)
        model.vm = Var(model.N, bounds=lambda m, i: (
            self.buses[i]['vmin'],
            self.buses[i]['vmax']
        ))

        # Bus voltage angle (radians)
        model.va = Var(model.N)

        # Branch power flows (MW) - from and to
        model.pf = Var(model.E)  # Power flow from bus
        model.pt = Var(model.E)  # Power flow to bus
        model.qf = Var(model.E)  # Reactive flow from bus
        model.qt = Var(model.E)  # Reactive flow to bus

        # Objective: Minimize generation cost
        def cost_rule(m):
            cost = 0
            for g in m.G:
                c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
                c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
                c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
                cost += c2 * m.pg[g]**2 + c1 * m.pg[g] + c0
            return cost

        model.cost = Objective(rule=cost_rule)

        # Constraints
        # 1. Reference bus angle = 0
        slack_bus = 1  # Assume bus 1 is slack
        model.ref_angle = Constraint(expr=model.va[slack_bus] == 0)

        # 2. Power flow equations - From bus i to j
        def pf_from_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180  # Convert to radians

            # Branch impedance
            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b = y.imag

            # Voltage angle difference
            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Power flow from i to j
            # P_ij = (G_ij + G_c_ij) * V_i^2 / tap^2 - G_ij * V_i * V_j * cos(theta_ij) / tap - B_ij * V_i * V_j * sin(theta_ij) / tap
            pf = (g / tap**2) * m.vm[from_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * cos(angle_diff) - \
                 (b / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.pf[e] == pf

        model.pf_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=pf_from_rule)

        # 3. Power flow equations - To bus j from i
        def pt_to_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Power flow to j from i
            # P_ji = G_ij * V_j^2 - G_ij * V_i * V_j * cos(theta_ij) / tap + B_ij * V_i * V_j * sin(theta_ij) / tap
            pt = g * m.vm[to_bus]**2 - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * cos(angle_diff) + \
                 (b / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.pt[e] == pt

        model.pt_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=pt_to_rule)

        # 4. Reactive power flow equations - From bus
        def qf_from_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            b = self.branches[e]['b']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b_ser = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Q flow from i to j
            qf = -(b_ser / tap**2 + b / 2) * m.vm[from_bus]**2 + \
                 (b_ser / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff) - \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[from_bus] * m.vm[to_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.qf[e] == qf

        model.qf_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=qf_from_rule)

        # 5. Reactive power flow equations - To bus
        def qt_to_rule(m, e):
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            r = self.branches[e]['r']
            x = self.branches[e]['x']
            b = self.branches[e]['b']
            tap = self.branches[e]['tap']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            z = r + 1j * x
            y = 1.0 / z if z != 0 else 1e-10
            g = y.real
            b_ser = y.imag

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            # Q flow to j from i
            qt = -(b_ser + b / 2) * m.vm[to_bus]**2 + \
                 (b_ser / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff) + \
                 (g / tap) * m.vm[to_bus] * m.vm[from_bus] * sin(angle_diff)

            return m.qt[e] == qt

        model.qt_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=qt_to_rule)

        # 6. Power balance equations at each bus
        def power_balance_p_rule(m, i):
            # Sum of generation - sum of loads - shunt = sum of flows
            gen_sum = sum(m.pg[g] for g in m.G if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load = self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            shunt_g = self.buses[i]['gs'] / self.base_MVA  # Convert to per-unit

            flow_out = sum(m.pf[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['from_bus'] == i)
            flow_in = sum(m.pt[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['to_bus'] == i)

            return gen_sum - load - shunt_g * m.vm[i]**2 == flow_out - flow_in

        model.power_balance_p = Constraint(model.N, rule=power_balance_p_rule)

        # 7. Reactive power balance equations
        def power_balance_q_rule(m, i):
            gen_sum = sum(m.qg[g] for g in m.G if self.generators[g]['bus'] == i)
            load = self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']
            shunt_b = self.buses[i]['bs'] / self.base_MVA  # Convert to per-unit

            flow_out = sum(m.qf[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['from_bus'] == i)
            flow_in = sum(m.qt[e] for e in m.E if self.branches[e]['to_bus'] == i)

            return gen_sum - load + shunt_b * m.vm[i]**2 == flow_out - flow_in

        model.power_balance_q = Constraint(model.N, rule=power_balance_q_rule)

        # 8. Branch power limits (MVA)
        def branch_limit_from_rule(m, e):
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']
            if rate_a > 0:
                return m.pf[e]**2 + m.qf[e]**2 <= rate_a**2
            return Constraint.Skip

        model.branch_limit_from = Constraint(model.E, rule=branch_limit_from_rule)

        def branch_limit_to_rule(m, e):
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']
            if rate_a > 0:
                return m.pt[e]**2 + m.qt[e]**2 <= rate_a**2
            return Constraint.Skip

        model.branch_limit_to = Constraint(model.E, rule=branch_limit_to_rule)

        # 9. Voltage angle difference limits
        def angle_limit_rule(m, e):
            # Usually -30 to +30 degrees, converted to radians
            angmin = -30 * np.pi / 180
            angmax = 30 * np.pi / 180
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            shift = self.branches[e]['shift'] * np.pi / 180

            angle_diff = m.va[from_bus] - m.va[to_bus] - shift

            return angmin <= angle_diff <= angmax

        model.angle_limit = Constraint(model.E, rule=angle_limit_rule)

        self.model = model
        return model

    def solve(self, solver_name='ipopt'):
        """Solve the OPF problem"""
        model = self.build_model()

        # Create solver
        solver = SolverFactory(solver_name)

        # Set solver options
        if solver_name == 'ipopt':
            solver.options['max_iter'] = 3000
            solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
            solver.options['print_level'] = 0

        # Solve
        print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")
        results = solver.solve(model, tee=False)

        return model, results

    def extract_solution(self, model, results):
        """Extract solution from solved model"""
        # Check solver status
        if results.solver.status == SolverStatus.ok:
            if results.solver.termination_condition == TerminationCondition.optimal:
                solver_status = "optimal"
            elif results.solver.termination_condition == TerminationCondition.locallyOptimal:
                solver_status = "locally_optimal"
            else:
                solver_status = str(results.solver.termination_condition)
        else:
            solver_status = str(results.solver.status)

        # Extract generator data
        generators = []
        total_gen_p = 0
        total_gen_q = 0
        total_cost = 0

        for g in model.G:
            bus = self.generators[g]['bus']
            pg = value(model.pg[g])
            qg = value(model.qg[g])
            pmin = self.generators[g]['pmin']
            pmax = self.generators[g]['pmax']
            qmin = self.generators[g]['qmin']
            qmax = self.generators[g]['qmax']

            # Calculate cost
            c2 = self.gen_costs[g]['c2']
            c1 = self.gen_costs[g]['c1']
            c0 = self.gen_costs[g]['c0']
            cost = c2 * pg**2 + c1 * pg + c0
            total_cost += cost

            total_gen_p += pg
            total_gen_q += qg

            generators.append({
                'id': int(g),
                'bus': int(bus),
                'pg_MW': float(pg),
                'qg_MVAr': float(qg),
                'pmin_MW': float(pmin),
                'pmax_MW': float(pmax),
                'qmin_MVAr': float(qmin),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(qmax)
            })

        # Extract bus data
        buses = []
        total_load_p = 0
        total_load_q = 0
        max_p_mismatch = 0
        max_q_mismatch = 0
        max_voltage_violation = 0

        for i in model.N:
            vm = value(model.vm[i])
            va = value(model.va[i]) * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
            vmin = self.buses[i]['vmin']
            vmax = self.buses[i]['vmax']

            total_load_p += self.buses[i]['pd_mw']
            total_load_q += self.buses[i]['qd_mvar']

            # Check voltage limits
            if vm < vmin:
                voltage_violation = vmin - vm
            elif vm > vmax:
                voltage_violation = vm - vmax
            else:
                voltage_violation = 0

            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, voltage_violation)

            buses.append({
                'id': int(i),
                'vm_pu': float(vm),
                'va_deg': float(va),
                'vmin_pu': float(vmin),
                'vmax_pu': float(vmax)
            })

        # Extract branch data
        branches = []
        max_branch_overload = 0

        for e in model.E:
            from_bus = self.branches[e]['from_bus']
            to_bus = self.branches[e]['to_bus']
            pf = value(model.pf[e])
            qf = value(model.qf[e])
            pt = value(model.pt[e])
            qt = value(model.qt[e])
            rate_a = self.branches[e]['rate_a']

            s_from = np.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
            s_to = np.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)

            if rate_a > 0:
                loading_pct = max(s_from, s_to) / rate_a * 100
                overload = max(s_from, s_to) - rate_a
                max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, max(0, overload))
            else:
                loading_pct = 0
                overload = 0

            branches.append({
                'from_bus': int(from_bus),
                'to_bus': int(to_bus),
                'loading_pct': float(loading_pct),
                'flow_from_MVA': float(s_from),
                'flow_to_MVA': float(s_to),
                'limit_MVA': float(rate_a)
            })

        # Sort branches by loading percentage (descending)
        branches_sorted = sorted(branches, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branches_sorted[:10]  # Top 10 most loaded branches

        # Calculate losses
        total_losses_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p

        return {
            'summary': {
                'total_cost_per_hour': float(total_cost),
                'total_load_MW': float(total_load_p),
                'total_load_MVAr': float(total_load_q),
                'total_generation_MW': float(total_gen_p),
                'total_generation_MVAr': float(total_gen_q),
                'total_losses_MW': float(total_losses_p),
                'solver_status': solver_status
            },
            'generators': generators,
            'buses': buses,
            'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
            'feasibility_check': {
                'max_p_mismatch_MW': float(max_p_mismatch),
                'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': float(max_q_mismatch),
                'max_voltage_violation_pu': float(max_voltage_violation),
                'max_branch_overload_MVA': float(max_branch_overload)
            }
        }


def main():
    # Solve OPF
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    model, results = solver.solve()

    # Extract and save results
    solution = solver.extract_solution(model, results)

    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(solution, f, indent=2)

    print("OPF Solution saved to report.json")
    print(f"Solver Status: {solution['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${solution['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:.2f}/hour")
    print(f"Total Generation: {solution['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Load: {solution['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Total Losses: {solution['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
